objective: Measure reuse of identical public source ciphertexts within one request under unchanged classical-128 and 0.001 gates.
baseline: same new binary with the flag off
short_gate: Both frozen two-token requests must pass.
full_design: Two paired 16-token comparisons: GPU 5 A then B; GPU 6 B then A. Placements fixed within pairs; concurrent jobs on separate CPU/NUMA/GPU resources.
adoption_screen: All token/numerical/security/circuit gates pass, both within-device pairs improve, pooled evaluation reduction at least 2%.
